LanguageData.CBF_ReserveGroundHelp: Before RimWorld places the rock, the edge of the mountain recedes where the settlement will stand, and only far enough for it to fit. The shape of the mountain is kept, the rest of the map is untouched. Off means the settlement has to make do with the terrain as grown and can fail on rocky tiles.
